basics.name: Maya Chen
basics.headline: Senior Product Designer · Design Systems & Growth
basics.summary: Product designer with 9 years of experience shipping B2B and consumer products. Leads cross-functional squads from discovery to launch, builds design systems that engineering teams actually adopt, and uses experiment data to decide what to ship. (Fictional example data.)

bullets: Led the redesign of the reporting workspace for 40,000 monthly active users, covering research, prototyping and handoff
Created the company design system (120 components, tokens, accessibility guidelines) adopted by 6 product squads
Cut time-to-first-report from 14 minutes to 5 minutes through onboarding experiments run with the growth team
Mentored 3 designers and ran the weekly design critique
evidence: Fictional example: figures come from the invented Q4 product review deck

bullets: Designed the checkout flow of the mobile app and partnered with engineering to ship it in two releases
Introduced usability testing every sprint; findings fed a prioritised backlog used by the product manager
Raised the mobile conversion rate from 2.1% to 2.9% across three A/B tests
Built a shared icon and illustration library used by web and mobile teams
evidence: Fictional example: invented A/B test report

bullets: Delivered websites and prototypes for 18 small-business clients
Ran stakeholder workshops and translated findings into wireframes and clickable prototypes
Open-source tool that converts design tokens to CSS, iOS and Android formats; used by 300+ teams
Wrote the documentation and review guidelines for external contributors
Checklist and workshop material for auditing web products against WCAG 2.1 AA
Graduated with honours; design thesis on accessible onboarding
